```{r}
# --- figure output redirected to _organized/figures/ ---
# Data files and CSV/RDS outputs keep their original paths.
fig_dir <- "../../../figures/data_analysis/ex_voe_matrix"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

folder_path <- "../../project1_ex/voe"

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# 分出 output, answer, 和数据文件
output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
answer_file <- csv_files[grepl("voe_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files) & 
                         !grepl("voe_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# 读取 output 和 answer
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output 已读取：", nrow(output), "行，", ncol(output), "列\n")

answer <- read.csv(answer_file, header = TRUE)
cat("answer 已读取：", nrow(answer), "行，", ncol(answer), "列\n")

# 读取其余文件为 dat_1, dat_2...
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " 已读取：", basename(data_files[i]),
               "（", nrow(dat), " 行，", ncol(dat), " 列）\n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("跳过：", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

save_path <- "."
# =========================================================
# Step 1. 构建 RT 矩阵（行 = Video，列 = participant）
# 同一个 Video × participant 如果有多条 trial，先取 mean
# =========================================================
rt_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_7.rt) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_7.rt)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_7.rt,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

rt_matrix <- rt_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("RT 矩阵维度：", dim(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("视频数：", nrow(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("被试数：", ncol(rt_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(rt_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. 每列 z-score（按 participant 标准化）
# 去掉不同被试整体快慢差异
# =========================================================
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# 去掉标准化后没有信息的列
keep_cols <- colSums(!is.na(rt_zscored)) > 1
rt_zscored <- rt_zscored[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("标准化后矩阵维度：", dim(rt_zscored), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. 计算 RDM
# 比较的是 video 和 video 之间的 dissimilarity
# correlation distance = 1 - Pearson correlation
# =========================================================
rdm_rt <- 1 - cor(
  t(rt_zscored),
  method = "pearson",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# 保证行列名是 Video
rownames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)
colnames(rdm_rt) <- rownames(rt_zscored)

cat("RDM 维度：", dim(rdm_rt), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 4. 可视化
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_rt,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - RT"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 5. 保存
# =========================================================
saveRDS(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.rds")
write.csv(rdm_rt, "human_rdm_rt.csv")
# 保存 rt_wide 到 save_path
```

```{r}
# 保存为 CSV
```

rdm_correctness
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================
# Step 1. 构建 correctness 矩阵（行 = Video，列 = participant）
# 同一个 Video × participant 如果有多条 trial，先取 mean
# 这样每个 cell 表示该 participant 对该 video 的正确率
# =========================================================
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_7.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_7.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = participant,
    values_from = key_resp_7.corr,
    values_fn   = mean
  )

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness 矩阵维度：", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("视频数：", nrow(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("被试数：", ncol(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 2. 计算 RDM
# 用平均绝对差（适合 binary / proportion correctness）
# d(i,j) = mean(|x_i - x_j|)
# =========================================================
video_ids <- rownames(corr_matrix)
n_video <- nrow(corr_matrix)

rdm_corr <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = n_video,
  ncol = n_video,
  dimnames = list(video_ids, video_ids)
)

for (i in seq_len(n_video)) {
  for (j in i:n_video) {
    xi <- corr_matrix[i, ]
    xj <- corr_matrix[j, ]
    
    keep <- !is.na(xi) & !is.na(xj)
    
    if (sum(keep) == 0) {
      d <- NA_real_
    } else {
      d <- mean(abs(xi[keep] - xj[keep]))
    }
    
    rdm_corr[i, j] <- d
    rdm_corr[j, i] <- d
  }
}

cat("RDM 维度：", dim(rdm_corr), "\n")

# =========================================================
# Step 3. 可视化
# =========================================================
pheatmap(
  rdm_corr,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  main = "Human RDM - Correctness"
)

# =========================================================
# Step 4. 保存
# =========================================================
save_path <- "."

if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.rds"))
write.csv(rdm_corr, file.path(save_path, "human_rdm_corr.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(corr_wide, file.path(save_path, "corr_wide.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ── Step 2: 每列计算 z-score ──────────────────────────
rt_zscored <- scale(rt_matrix, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# ── Step 3: 跑 PCA ───────────────────────────────────
pca_rt <- prcomp(rt_zscored, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: 查看方差解释 ──────────────────────────────
var_explained <- summary(pca_rt)$importance
cat("=== 各 PC 方差解释 ===\n")
print(round(var_explained[, 1:10], 3))

# 找到解释 80% 和 90% 方差所需的 PC 数量
cum_var <- cumsum(pca_rt$sdev^2 / sum(pca_rt$sdev^2))
k_80 <- which(cum_var >= 0.80)[1]
k_90 <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
cat("\n解释 80% 方差需要", k_80, "个 PC\n")
cat("解释 90% 方差需要", k_90, "个 PC\n")

# ── Step 5: 可视化方差解释 ───────────────────────────
plot(cum_var, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of PCs",
     ylab = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
     main = "Intuitive - RT PCA")
abline(h = 0.80, col = "blue", lty = 2)
abline(h = 0.90, col = "red",  lty = 2)
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("80%", "90%"),
       col    = c("blue", "red"),
       lty    = 2)

# ── Step 6: 每个视频在每个 PC 上的得分 ──────────────
pc_scores <- pca_rt$x
cat("\n=== 视频 PC 得分（前5行，前5个PC）===\n")
print(round(pc_scores[1:5, 1:5], 3))

# ── Step 7: 每个 PC 得分最高和最低的视频 ────────────
cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_90) {
  scores <- pc_scores[, k]
  top10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
  bot10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  最高：", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r}
library(logisticPCA)

# ── Step 1: 构建 Correctness 矩阵 ────────────────────
corr_wide <- all_cat %>%
  dplyr::select(Video, participant, key_resp_7.corr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(key_resp_7.corr)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = participant,
              values_from = key_resp_7.corr,
              values_fn   = mean)

corr_matrix <- corr_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Video") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Correctness 矩阵维度：", dim(corr_matrix), "\n")
cat("缺失值数量：", sum(is.na(corr_matrix)), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Cross-validation 选最优 k ────────────────
logpca_cv <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:10, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv)
k_opt <- which.min(rowMeans(logpca_cv))
cat("最优 k：", k_opt, "\n")

# ── Step 3: 跑 Logistic PCA ───────────────────────────
logpca_model <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k_opt, m = 4)

# ── Step 4: 每个视频的 PC 得分 ───────────────────────
pc_scores_corr <- logpca_model$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:k_opt) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr[, k]
  top10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
  bot10   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  最高：", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot10, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ── Step 5: 方差解释 ──────────────────────────────────
cat("\n=== 方差解释 ===\n")
var_exp <- logpca_model$prop_deviance_expl
cat("各 PC 解释的方差比例：\n")
print(round(var_exp, 3))

# ── Step 6: 保存 ─────────────────────────────────────
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "voe_correctness_logisticPCA_scores.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n完成！Logistic PCA scores 已保存\n")
```

```{r}
# ── Step 5.5: Scree Plot ──────────────────────────────
max_k <- 20
var_by_k <- numeric(max_k)

for (k in 1:max_k) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  var_by_k[k] <- m$prop_deviance_expl
}

# 每个 PC 新增的边际方差
marginal_var <- c(var_by_k[1], diff(var_by_k))

scree_df_corr <- data.frame(
  PC           = 1:max_k,
  Marginal_Var = marginal_var
)

p_scree_corr <- ggplot(scree_df_corr, aes(x = PC, y = Marginal_Var)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:max_k) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot - Correctness Logistic PCA",
       x = "Component Number",
       y = "Marginal Variance Explained") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.line   = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_scree_corr)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.pdf"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300, device = cairo_pdf
)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "correctness_logisticPCA_scree.png"),
  plot = p_scree_corr, width = 90, height = 80, units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
cat("Correctness Scree plot 已保存！\n")
```

CV 曲线仍然单调下降，k=10 只是上限
k=10 解释 86.3% 方差
与 CAT 类似，需要扩大搜索范围确认最优 k

```{r}
# 扩大 k 的范围重新 CV
logpca_cv2 <- cv.lpca(corr_matrix, ks = 1:20, ms = 4)
plot(logpca_cv2)

# 手动看哪里有肘部
cv_means <- rowMeans(logpca_cv2)
cat("各 k 的 CV 得分：\n")
print(round(cv_means, 2))

# 用肘部法则找最优 k
# 计算斜率变化
diffs <- diff(cv_means)
diffs2 <- diff(diffs)
k_elbow <- which.min(diffs2) + 1
cat("肘部法则建议 k =", k_elbow, "\n")

# 或者选择方差解释达到 80% 的最小 k
# 重新跑不同 k 看方差解释
for (k in c(3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20)) {
  m <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = k, m = 4)
  cat(paste0("k=", k, ": 方差解释 = ", round(m$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n"))
}
```

建议用 k=14，理由：

曲线在 k=11-14 有真实的弯折平台
k=15 解释 73% 方差，k=14 约 70%
与 CAT (k=15) 量级相近，便于比较

```{r}
# 用 k=10 重新跑 Logistic PCA
logpca_final <- logisticPCA(corr_matrix, k = 14, m = 4)

cat("方差解释：", round(logpca_final$prop_deviance_expl, 3), "\n")

# PC scores
pc_scores_corr_final <- logpca_final$PCs
rownames(pc_scores_corr_final) <- rownames(corr_matrix)

cat("\n=== 各 PC 得分最高/最低的视频 ===\n")
for (k in 1:14) {
  scores <- pc_scores_corr_final[, k]
  top3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
  bot3   <- names(sort(scores, decreasing = FALSE))[1:3]
  cat(paste0("\nPC", k, ":\n"))
  cat("  最高：", paste(top3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  最低：", paste(bot3, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# 保存
pc_scores_corr_df <- as.data.frame(pc_scores_corr_final)
colnames(pc_scores_corr_df) <- paste0("PC", 1:14)
pc_scores_corr_df$Video <- rownames(corr_matrix)
pc_scores_corr_df <- pc_scores_corr_df %>% dplyr::select(Video, everything())

write.csv(pc_scores_corr_df,
          file.path(save_path, "voe_correctness_logisticPCA_k14.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n完成！k=14 的 Logistic PCA scores 已保存\n")
```

```{r voe_pc123_flat_biplots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_readable_video_label <- function(video) {
  video_key <- str_sub(clean_video_label(video), 1, 12)
  mapped <- video_readable_label_map[video_key]
  ifelse(is.na(mapped), video_key, mapped)
}

prepare_semantic_pc_scores <- function(scores_df, pc_labels, pc_short_labels) {
  scores_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Video, PC1, PC2, PC3) %>%
    mutate(
      PC1_raw = PC1,
      PC2_raw = PC2,
      PC3_raw = PC3,
      PC1 = PC1_raw - mean(PC1_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      PC2 = PC2_raw - mean(PC2_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      PC3 = PC3_raw - mean(PC3_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
      video_name = clean_video_label(Video),
      video_key = str_sub(video_name, 1, 12),
      video_label = make_readable_video_label(Video),
      dominant_pc = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")[
        max.col(abs(cbind(PC1, PC2, PC3)), ties.method = "first")
      ],
      dominant_pc = factor(dominant_pc, levels = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")),
      dominant_dimension = factor(
        pc_labels[as.character(dominant_pc)],
        levels = pc_labels[c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")]
      ),
      dominant_short = pc_short_labels[as.character(dominant_pc)],
      plot_label = paste0(dominant_short, "-", video_label),
      dominant_score = pmax(abs(PC1), abs(PC2), abs(PC3))
    )
}

make_pc123_semantic_biplot <- function(scores_df,
                                       title,
                                       output_prefix,
                                       pc_labels,
                                       pc_short_labels,
                                       label_n_each_pc = 6,
                                       pc3_scale = 0.45,
                                       pc3_angle = 45,
                                       coord_ratio = 1,
                                       label_below = character(),
                                       label_below_offset = 0.8,
                                       label_nudges = NULL,
                                       axis_label_nudges = NULL,
                                       x_breaks = NULL,
                                       width = 12,
                                       height = 9) {
  angle_rad <- pc3_angle * pi / 180
  pc3_x_unit <- cos(angle_rad)
  pc3_y_unit <- sin(angle_rad) / coord_ratio

  plot_df <- prepare_semantic_pc_scores(scores_df, pc_labels, pc_short_labels) %>%
    mutate(
      plot_x = PC1 + pc3_scale * PC3 * pc3_x_unit,
      plot_y = PC2 + pc3_scale * PC3 * pc3_y_unit
    )

  pc_membership <- plot_df %>%
    arrange(dominant_pc, desc(dominant_score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Video, video_key, video_label, plot_label,
      dominant_pc, dominant_dimension, dominant_short, dominant_score,
      PC1, PC2, PC3, PC1_raw, PC2_raw, PC3_raw, plot_x, plot_y
    )

  write_csv(
    pc_membership,
    file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_video_membership.csv"))
  )
  write_csv(
    pc_membership,
    file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_semantic_video_membership.csv"))
  )

  top_videos <- bind_rows(lapply(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"), function(one_pc) {
    plot_df %>%
      filter(dominant_pc == one_pc) %>%
      slice_max(dominant_score, n = label_n_each_pc, with_ties = FALSE)
  })) %>%
    distinct(Video, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(nudge_x = 0, nudge_y = 0)

  if (!is.null(label_nudges)) {
    top_videos <- top_videos %>%
      left_join(label_nudges, by = "video_key", suffix = c("", "_custom")) %>%
      mutate(
        nudge_x = coalesce(nudge_x_custom, nudge_x),
        nudge_y = coalesce(nudge_y_custom, nudge_y)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-ends_with("_custom"))
  }

  top_videos <- top_videos %>%
    mutate(
      label_x = plot_x + nudge_x,
      label_y = plot_y + nudge_y
    )

  manual_label_df <- top_videos %>%
    filter(video_key %in% label_below) %>%
    mutate(
      label_x = plot_x + nudge_x,
      label_y = plot_y - label_below_offset + nudge_y
    )
  label_df <- top_videos %>%
    filter(!video_key %in% label_below)

  x_rng <- range(plot_df$plot_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_rng <- range(plot_df$plot_y, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_span <- diff(x_rng)
  y_span <- diff(y_rng)
  axis_len <- max(abs(c(x_rng, y_rng)), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02
  pc3_axis_len <- axis_len * 0.66

  axis_df <- tibble(
    axis = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"),
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    xend = c(axis_len, 0, pc3_axis_len * pc3_x_unit),
    yend = c(0, axis_len, pc3_axis_len * pc3_y_unit),
    label_x = c(axis_len * 0.78, -axis_len * 0.08, pc3_axis_len * pc3_x_unit * 1.04),
    label_y = c(axis_len * 0.055, axis_len * 0.96, pc3_axis_len * pc3_y_unit * 1.10),
    label = c(
      paste0("Dim 1\n", pc_labels["PC1"]),
      paste0("Dim 2\n", pc_labels["PC2"]),
      paste0("Dim 3\n", pc_labels["PC3"])
    ),
    hjust = c(0, 1, 0),
    vjust = c(0, 0.5, 0.5)
  )

  if (!is.null(axis_label_nudges)) {
    axis_df <- axis_df %>%
      left_join(axis_label_nudges, by = "axis", suffix = c("", "_custom")) %>%
      mutate(
        label_x = label_x + coalesce(nudge_x, 0),
        label_y = label_y + coalesce(nudge_y, 0)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-nudge_x, -nudge_y)
  }

  pc_cols <- setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73"), pc_labels)
  pc_fills <- setNames(c("#F6CDBB", "#CFE6F3", "#CDEAD9"), pc_labels)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y, color = dominant_dimension)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45) +
    stat_ellipse(
      geom = "polygon", type = "norm", level = 0.68,
      aes(fill = dominant_dimension),
      alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = axis_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.24, "inches")),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = axis_df,
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5.1, color = "black", lineheight = 0.92
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.86) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = plot_label),
      size = 4.0,
      color = "black",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey55",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = manual_label_df,
      aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = plot_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4.0,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pc_cols, name = "Dominant Dimension") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pc_fills, name = "Dominant Dimension") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = paste0("Dim 1: ", pc_labels["PC1"]),
      y = paste0("Dim 2: ", pc_labels["PC2"])
    ) +
    coord_fixed(
      ratio = coord_ratio,
      xlim = c(min(x_rng[1], -axis_len * 0.22) - x_span * 0.12, axis_len * 1.10),
      ylim = c(min(y_rng[1], -axis_len * 0.20) - y_span * 0.12, axis_len * 1.08),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey86", linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 26, 12, 18)
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
    )

  if (!is.null(x_breaks)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, minor_breaks = NULL)
  }

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_semantic_biplot.png")),
         p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_semantic_biplot.pdf")),
         p, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_flat_biplot.png")),
         p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_PC123_flat_biplot.pdf")),
         p, width = width, height = height, device = cairo_pdf)

  list(plot = p, membership = pc_membership)
}
```

```{r voe_video_rsm_matrices, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

save_path <- "."

make_video_rsm_plot <- function(rdm_file, title, output_prefix) {
  rdm <- read.csv(
    file.path(save_path, rdm_file),
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rdm[is.na(rdm)] <- max(rdm, na.rm = TRUE)
  diag(rdm) <- 0

  sim <- 1 - (rdm / max(rdm, na.rm = TRUE))
  sim[sim < 0] <- 0
  sim[sim > 1] <- 1
  diag(sim) <- 1

  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Video_row") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Video_row, names_to = "Video_col", values_to = "Similarity") %>%
    mutate(
      row_label = str_sub(str_remove(basename(Video_row), "\\.mp4$"), 1, 10),
      col_label = str_sub(str_remove(basename(Video_col), "\\.mp4$"), 1, 10),
      row_label = factor(row_label, levels = str_sub(str_remove(basename(video_order), "\\.mp4$"), 1, 10)),
      col_label = factor(col_label, levels = str_sub(str_remove(basename(video_order), "\\.mp4$"), 1, 10))
    )

  p <- ggplot(sim_df, aes(x = col_label, y = row_label, fill = Similarity)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#E43D30", "#FDBB6C", "#FFFFBF", "#ABD9E9", "#2166AC"),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      name = "Similarity"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8, color = "grey35"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey35"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
    )

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.png")),
         p, width = 12, height = 11, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.pdf")),
         p, width = 12, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)

  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}

read_rsm_label_info <- function(path) {
  read_csv(file.path(save_path, path), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      rsm_label = plot_label,
      dominant_pc = factor(dominant_pc, levels = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Video, video_key, video_label, rsm_label, dominant_pc,
                  dominant_dimension, dominant_short, dominant_score) %>%
    distinct(Video, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

make_similarity_clustered_video_order <- function(similarity_matrix,
                                                  low_similarity_first = FALSE) {
  sim <- (similarity_matrix + t(similarity_matrix)) / 2
  diag(sim) <- 1

  sim_distance <- 1 - sim
  diag(sim_distance) <- 0

  sim_hclust <- hclust(as.dist(sim_distance), method = "average")
  video_order <- sim_hclust$labels[sim_hclust$order]

  average_similarity <- rowMeans(
    replace(sim, row(sim) == col(sim), NA),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  first_is_lower <- average_similarity[video_order[1]] <
    average_similarity[video_order[length(video_order)]]

  if ((!low_similarity_first && first_is_lower) ||
      (low_similarity_first && !first_is_lower)) {
    video_order <- rev(video_order)
  }

  video_order
}

make_pc_grouped_video_order <- function(similarity_matrix,
                                        label_info,
                                        low_similarity_first_pcs = character()) {
  video_names <- rownames(similarity_matrix)
  label_info <- label_info %>%
    filter(Video %in% video_names) %>%
    mutate(dominant_pc = factor(dominant_pc, levels = c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3")))

  grouped_order <- unlist(lapply(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"), function(one_pc) {
    group_videos <- label_info %>%
      filter(as.character(dominant_pc) == one_pc) %>%
      pull(Video)

    if (length(group_videos) <= 2) {
      return(group_videos)
    }

    group_sim <- similarity_matrix[group_videos, group_videos, drop = FALSE]
    make_similarity_clustered_video_order(
      group_sim,
      low_similarity_first = one_pc %in% low_similarity_first_pcs
    )
  }), use.names = FALSE)

  c(grouped_order, setdiff(video_names, grouped_order))
}

make_pc_grouped_video_rsm_plot <- function(rdm_file,
                                           label_info_file,
                                           title,
                                           output_prefix,
                                           low_similarity_first_pcs = character()) {
  rdm <- read.csv(
    file.path(save_path, rdm_file),
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rdm[is.na(rdm)] <- max(rdm, na.rm = TRUE)
  diag(rdm) <- 0

  sim <- 1 - (rdm / max(rdm, na.rm = TRUE))
  sim[sim < 0] <- 0
  sim[sim > 1] <- 1
  diag(sim) <- 1

  label_info <- read_rsm_label_info(label_info_file)
  video_order <- make_pc_grouped_video_order(
    sim,
    label_info,
    low_similarity_first_pcs = low_similarity_first_pcs
  )

  order_df <- tibble(Video = video_order, plot_order = seq_along(video_order)) %>%
    left_join(label_info, by = "Video") %>%
    mutate(
      rsm_label = ifelse(is.na(rsm_label),
                         str_sub(str_remove(basename(Video), "\\.mp4$"), 1, 10),
                         rsm_label)
    )

  group_boxes <- order_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(dominant_pc)) %>%
    group_by(dominant_pc, dominant_dimension) %>%
    summarise(
      xmin = min(plot_order) - 0.47,
      xmax = max(plot_order) + 0.47,
      ymin = min(plot_order) - 0.47,
      ymax = max(plot_order) + 0.47,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(dominant_pc)

  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Video_row") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Video_row, names_to = "Video_col", values_to = "Similarity") %>%
    left_join(order_df %>% dplyr::select(Video_row = Video, row_idx = plot_order),
              by = "Video_row") %>%
    left_join(order_df %>% dplyr::select(Video_col = Video, col_idx = plot_order),
              by = "Video_col") %>%
    filter(!is.na(row_idx), !is.na(col_idx))

  write_csv(
    order_df %>%
      dplyr::select(plot_order, Video, video_key, video_label, rsm_label,
                    dominant_pc, dominant_dimension, dominant_short, dominant_score),
    file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM_grouped_by_PC_order.csv"))
  )
  write_csv(
    order_df %>%
      dplyr::select(plot_order, Video, video_key, video_label, rsm_label,
                    dominant_pc, dominant_dimension, dominant_short, dominant_score),
    file.path(save_path, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM_semantic_order.csv"))
  )

  p <- ggplot(sim_df, aes(x = col_idx, y = row_idx, fill = Similarity)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_rect(
      data = group_boxes,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = NA,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = order_df$plot_order,
      labels = order_df$rsm_label,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = order_df$plot_order,
      labels = order_df$rsm_label,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#E43D30", "#FDBB6C", "#FFFFBF", "#ABD9E9", "#2166AC"),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      name = "Similarity"
    ) +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7.4, color = "grey30"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.6, color = "grey30"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
    )

  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.png")),
         p, width = 12, height = 11, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_video_RSM.pdf")),
         p, width = 12, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)

  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}

make_pc_grouped_video_rsm_plot(
  rdm_file = "human_rdm_rt.csv",
  label_info_file = "voe_RT_PC123_semantic_video_membership.csv",
  title = "Intuitive - RT Video RSM",
  output_prefix = "voe_RT"
)

make_pc_grouped_video_rsm_plot(
  rdm_file = "human_rdm_corr.csv",
  label_info_file = "voe_correctness_logisticPCA_PC123_semantic_video_membership.csv",
  title = "Intuitive - Correctness Video RSM",
  output_prefix = "voe_correctness",
  low_similarity_first_pcs = "PC1"
)

cat("完成！RT 和 Correctness 的 Video RSM matrix 图已保存。\n")
```
